bonus_rules.label: Google Summer of Code
bonus_rules.description: Google Summer of Code participation only; +5 if evidenced, otherwise 0.

bonus_rules.label: Girl Script Summer of Code
bonus_rules.description: Girl Script Summer of Code participation only; +3 if evidenced, otherwise 0.

bonus_rules.label: HackerRank Orchestrate
bonus_rules.description: Read the awards section for HackerRank Orchestrate. Return its best stated rank, matching tier points, and the supporting award. Return rank null and points 0 if absent; do not use Codeforces, LeetCode, CodeChef, or other contest ranks. Python validates that points match the rank tier.

bonus_rules.label: Startup founder/co-founder
bonus_rules.description: Startup founder/co-founder experience; 3-5 if evidenced, otherwise 0. Building a personal project or an internship alone does not qualify.

bonus_rules.label: Early-stage engineer
bonus_rules.description: Evidence of being among the first 10-20 engineers at a startup; 2-3 if evidenced, otherwise 0. An internship alone does not establish this.

bonus_rules.label: Portfolio website
bonus_rules.description: An explicit personal portfolio website earns +2; GitHub projects and competitive-programming profiles do not qualify.

bonus_rules.label: LinkedIn profile
bonus_rules.description: LinkedIn profile in resume profiles; +1 if present, otherwise 0.

bonus_rules.label: Technical blogs
bonus_rules.description: High-quality technical blogs only when blog data is provided; 1-3 if evidenced, otherwise 0.
